title_as_printed: Experimental dissolved gas concentrations in the aqueous phase in equilibrium with gas hydrates at temperature T/K and pressure p/MPa. Xc1, Xc2, Xc3: mole fractions of methane (C1), ethane (C2) and propane (C3) in the aqueous phase. The feed composition is estimated to be in mole fractions: methane 3.455 x 10^-2, ethane 6.98 x 10^-3, propane 3.47 x 10^-3 and water 9.55 x 10^-1.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Estimated uncertainties: u(T/K) = 0.03, u(p/MPa) = 0.01, u(Xc1) = 0.1 x 10^-3, u(Xc2) = 0.012 x 10^-3 and u(Xc3) = 0.007 x 10^-3.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Three phase equilibrium between the hydrate, the aqueous and the vapor phase.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Two phase equilibrium between the aqueous and the vapor phase.

pressure_note: reactor pressure p/MPa (transducer, u=0.01 MPa); total vs gas partial not stated; reactor holds hydrate + aqueous phase (water injected to set pressure), vapour-unsaturated, so no free gas phase except rows flagged b/c

composition.other_species: pure deionised water; solute is a ternary CH4/C2H6/C3H8 gas mixture (mixture A 76.77/15.51/7.72 mol%, mixture B 75.31/16.16/8.53 mol%; which mixture was used per row not stated). Table gives mole fractions of each gas in the aqueous phase; no salt.

notes: Three solute gases per row, each its own mole fraction (value, value2, value3). Mole fractions are on a total-aqueous-phase basis (water + dissolved gases); salt-free. Note column holds footnote letters attached to T values. Row 293.15 carries footnote letter a (printed), which refers to the uncertainty footnote; kept as printed. Rows flagged b (294.07, 295.14, 296.10, 297.17) are three-phase hydrate-aqueous-vapour equilibria; the row flagged c (299.13) is two-phase aqueous-vapour equilibrium with NO hydrate (regime should be blank for that row). Other rows are aqueous-hydrate equilibria in the absence of a vapour phase (hydrate-aqueous, vapour unsaturated). Pressure varies 6.22-20.10 MPa; T 274.55-299.13 K.

row_regime_overrides.reason: 299.13 K row (footnote c): no hydrate, two-phase aqueous-vapour (audit 2026-10-02)
